title: Seidelmann, P. K. (ed.) (1992). Explanatory Supplement to the Astronomical Almanac: section 1.54 Eclipses, Occultations, and Transits; section 8.1 Introduction to chapter 8, Eclipses of the Sun and Moon (Fiala, A. D. and Bangert, J. A.); and the glossary entry "occultation"
note: Read in the archive.org full text. Source of the definitions of eclipse, occultation, transit and shadow transit; the statement that by strict application a solar eclipse is really an occultation; the chapter 8 description of a transit as a planet's shadow falling on the Earth; and the glossary rule that an occultation cutting off a reflecting body's illumination is also called an eclipse.
